name: ephemera
description: Disposable, fully isolated environments on Zerops - one per pull request, one per AI agent task.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/web && cp src/web/dashboard.html dist/web/dashboard.html
scripts.test: tsx --test src/zerops/manifest.test.ts src/environments/cost.test.ts src/environments/validate.test.ts src/github/name.test.ts src/detect/detect.test.ts src/secrets/crypto.test.ts
